headline: Non-executive director acquires 50,000 units on market
summary: A non-executive director purchased 50,000 units at $2.18 per unit, increasing their total holding to 410,000 units. This is a routine director interest notice.

headline: $85m placement at 9.5% discount to fund $120m clinic acquisition
summary: Placement dilutes existing holders at a discount, but funds acquisition of 14 day-surgery clinics expected to be EPS accretive in year one. Balance funded from debt. Strategic expansion offset by dilution.

headline: FY27 production guidance cut after pit wall failure closes haul road
summary: A pit wall failure has closed the main haul road for ~8 weeks, reducing FY27 copper production guidance and raising AISC by 12%. No injuries. Remediation underway; update due in January.

headline: Half-year revenue up 31% to $48.2m, first positive operating cash flow
summary: Quokka Software reported strong half-year revenue growth and its first positive operating cash flow. Full-year guidance remains unchanged, indicating confidence in continued performance.

headline: CEO resigns after six years, effective 31 January 2027
summary: The long-serving CEO is departing. The board is searching for a successor, with the CFO to act as interim CEO if needed. Leadership uncertainty may weigh on investor sentiment.

headline: All AGM resolutions passed on a poll
summary: Routine annual general meeting outcome; all resolutions were approved by shareholders. No material impact expected for investors.
